project: InnoMaker USB-to-CAN Setup on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano

setup_steps.title: Install dependencies and kernel headers
setup_steps.description: Install essential build utilities, DKMS, and NVIDIA Tegra kernel headers required to compile external modules.
setup_steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y git build-essential dkms nvidia-l4t-kernel-headers can-utils

setup_steps.title: Clone the gs_usb source repository
setup_steps.description: Download the standalone gs_usb driver adapted for Linux 5.15 directly into the DKMS source path.

setup_steps.title: Register, compile, and install via DKMS
setup_steps.description: Register the module with DKMS and build it against the running Tegra kernel.
setup_steps.command: sudo dkms add -m gs_usb -v 5.15 && sudo dkms build -m gs_usb -v 5.15 && sudo dkms install -m gs_usb -v 5.15

setup_steps.title: Load the gs_usb kernel module
setup_steps.description: Load the compiled driver module into the active Linux kernel.

setup_steps.title: Bring up the CAN interface
setup_steps.description: Configure bitrate to 500 kbps, disable loopback for real hardware comms, and set the link to UP.
setup_steps.command: sudo ip link set can1 down && sudo ip link set can1 type can bitrate 500000 loopback off && sudo ip link set can1 up

setup_steps.title: Verify interface state
setup_steps.description: Confirm that can1 is online and functioning properly without bus errors.

setup_steps.title: Monitor live CAN traffic
setup_steps.description: Listen for incoming CAN frames sent by connected nodes such as VESC motor controllers.

quick_reference_notes.interface_naming: can0 belongs to the internal Orin Nano controller (mttcan). The InnoMaker USB adapter is assigned to can1.
quick_reference_notes.jetpack6_context: gs_usb is omitted from the default JetPack 6 defconfig. DKMS ensures the driver automatically rebuilds if the kernel updates.
quick_reference_notes.vesc_addressing: VESC uses 29-bit extended CAN IDs. The target controller ID (e.g., 1 or 2) occupies the lowest 8 bits.
quick_reference_notes.hardware_termination: Ensure the 120-ohm termination switch on the InnoMaker adapter is set to ON and common GND is connected to all controllers.
